title: geranium ficaria
intro: Geranium ficaria, commonly known as wood geranium or Spotted Geranium, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Geranium genus. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geranium ficaria include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
